title: Fee Settlement with a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Catch-Up Payment
content:
**Collections desk guidance, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — fees settled with a catch-up payment.**

**Rule.** When the contract shows a late charge assessed after the same day of the previous calendar month and is not enrolled in autopay, the catch-up amount also includes an amount equal to the whole fees-due balance; when it shows such a late charge and is enrolled in autopay, it includes an amount equal to the fees-due balance up to the product's company maximum late charge of 30.00 dollars (the same 30.00 dollars on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3, Tier 2, Tier 1 and Tier 1+), the rest being left to the next autopay draft; in every other case it includes no amount for fees.

The amount for fees is added to the catch-up amount.

**Records and counting.** A late charge assessed after the same day of the previous calendar month is a late charge entry on the contract's ledger dated within the last 1 calendar month, today included; autopay enrolment is read from the contract record. Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment; an entry lies in the last N calendar months when its date is not after today and fewer than N whole months run from its date to today, which is the same as being dated after the same day number N months before today.

| Late charge in the last calendar month | Autopay | Amount included for fees |
|---|---|---|
| yes | not enrolled | the whole fees-due balance |
| yes | enrolled | the fees-due balance, but no more than 30.00 dollars |
| no | either | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Today the 9th; a late charge dated the 10th of the previous month; fees due 64.00 dollars; no autopay: 64.00 dollars are included. With autopay: 30.00 dollars are included, the other 34.00 dollars being left to the next autopay draft.
- Today the 9th; the latest late charge dated the 9th of the previous month: it is not after that day, so nothing is included for fees.
